items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve the link before accepting npm ownership**

When an existing link lexically starts with the allowed prefix but escapes it with `..`—for example, `../lib/node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent/../../../../foreign/omp`—this glob treats it as npm-owned and leaves it in place. npm resolves the link target before checking containment and rejects an outside target with `EEXIST` ([npm bin-links ownership check](https://github.com/npm/bin-links/blob/main/lib/check-bin.js#L38-L57)); an `npm install -g` reproduction therefore still fails for a link this change promises to handle. Resolve or normalize the target before deciding whether to move it aside.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
